contradictions.conflict: At least four BRCA2 Δβ numbers circulate without a unified caliber label: −0.122 (HP-axis), −0.023 (within-tag cis), ~0.007 (per-CpG mean-shift), and −0.054 (dup-bug artifact). Docs mix them as if interchangeable.
contradictions.which_correct: All four are real but are DIFFERENT measures, not contradictory values: copy_partition_confirm.json gives d_HP=-0.122 / d_within=-0.023 / d_copy=-0.11 / d_allele=-0.099; ~0.007 is a non-directional per-CpG mean-shift (obs24_H2 CI [-0.0075,0.0126] straddles 0); −0.054 is the buggy 5mC+5hmC double-count artifact (now corrected to −0.122 via max-collapse, ledger #53). The error is presenting them without caliber tags, not the numbers themselves.
contradictions.correction_needed: Tag every BRCA2 Δβ with its caliber (HP-axis −0.122 / within-tag cis −0.023 / per-CpG ~0.007 / DO-NOT-USE buggy −0.054). The headline magnitude should be HP-axis −0.122; the cis-relevant magnitude is within-tag −0.023 (marginal, n=19/19 single-sample). Resolve 08-45 'source pending' before submission.

contradictions.subject: chr17/TBC1D16 'clean cis' exemplar qualification
contradictions.claim_a: [formal_arch G08 05-24], [direction_cards G08 08-18], [catalog_r6 G08 15-03/15-43], [prereg_fallback G08 14-04], [validation_map G08 09-22] all label chr17 the 'unique CLEAN somatic cis' (d_within 0.142 ≫ d_copy 0.029, perm p=0.001), and 09-22/13-21 assert it 'separates germline-allelic from cis'.
contradictions.claim_b: chr17's own primary data (copy_partition_confirm.json) has d_allele=0.183 > d_within=0.142, plus cramersV_value=0.0 / clustering_reliability=none (fails the project's own Cochran gate); perm p=0.001 rests on n=30 reads (16 alt/14 ref) at one CpG-aggregated locus. [formal_arch G08 05-29] itself concedes Bonferroni×816≈0.82 may render it NS.
contradictions.conflict: The cross-doc 'clean cis' framing controls only the COPY axis (d_within vs d_copy) and ignores that the germline-allelic ALLELE axis (d_allele=0.183) is LARGER than the within signal — the exemplar's own data contradicts 'germline-allelic separated from cis'. 'Clean' also conflicts with cramersV=0/reliability=none and the doc's own Bonferroni caveat.
contradictions.which_correct: claim_b (primary) wins on rigor. chr17 is the BEST cis candidate and uniquely passes the within>copy test, but 'clean' is overstated: residual allele-axis (per memory feedback_asm_allele_axis_baseline_confound) is unexplained, it fails the Cochran reliability gate, and it is nominal/Bonferroni-marginal single-sample (n=30). The within>copy uniqueness (TAG-A=1) is real and survives.
contradictions.correction_needed: Soften 'clean cis' to 'best/strongest cis candidate, copy-axis controlled' across formal_arch/direction_cards/catalog_r6/prereg_fallback/validation_map; disclose d_allele=0.183>d_within, cramersV=0/reliability=none, n=30 reads, and Bonferroni-marginal single-sample. contradictions.claim_a: [formal_arch G09 05-02/05-11] / [master_map G09 06-33] / [catalog_r6 G01 15-18, G09 15-12] state 'reliable methylation clustering at 12,868 loci, all germline-allelic' and use TAG-G none=291,518.

contradictions.conflict: Three different 'reliable' counts (12,868 TAG-C / 12,876 tristate / 11,689 TP+FP) and three different 'none' counts (291,518 TAG-G / 291,552 tristate / 292,762 mixed-caliber) circulate across docs without one declared convention; a reader cannot reconcile them. Worse, '12,868 reliable all germline-allelic' is near-tautological: TAG-C is DEFINED as reliable AND germline-allelic, so it cannot evidence that reliable clustering is 'overwhelmingly germline'.
contradictions.which_correct: undetermined as a single 'correct' number — each caliber is internally valid (TAG-C=12,868 and TAG-G=291,518 are grep-exact; tristate 12,876/291,552 and TP+FP 11,689/292,762 are also real). The DEFECT is mixing calibers across docs and the by-construction tautology in the 'all germline-allelic' inference, not a wrong value.
contradictions.correction_needed: Declare ONE canonical caliber (recommend TAG-based: reliable=12,868 TAG-C, latent=28,254 TAG-E, none=291,518 TAG-G summing to 332,705) and use it consistently; report what fraction of reliable-clustering (tristate 12,876, which includes non-germline) is germline-allelic SEPARATELY rather than asserting '12,868 all germline' (tautological).
